notes: Ensure that only Python-related commands are modified. Non-Python commands should remain unchanged.

steps.description: Identify all instances of 'pytest' command usage in the planner code
steps.details: Search through the planner's codebase to find all occurrences where 'pytest' is used as a command. This includes any test execution steps in the generated plans.

Replace all instances of 'pytest' with 'python -m pytest' in the planner's codebase. Ensure that the changes are made only to the test execution steps and do not affect any non-Python related commands.

steps.description: Identify all instances of 'pip install' command usage in the planner code
steps.details: Search through the planner's codebase to find all occurrences where 'pip install' is used as a command. This includes any dependency installation steps in the generated plans.

steps.description: Modify 'pip install' commands to use 'python -m pip install'
steps.details: Replace all instances of 'pip install <package>' with 'python -m pip install <package>' in the planner's codebase. Ensure that the changes are made only to the dependency installation steps and do not affect any non-Python related commands.

steps.description: Verify changes in the planner's generated plans
steps.details: Run the planner's test suite to ensure that the changes to the command syntax do not break any existing functionality. Check that all generated plans now use 'python -m pytest' and 'python -m pip install' where applicable.
